audit.whatIsWrong: Five stages read 'Skill' while the page's own prose says Teemo controls levels 2 through first item and that late flips to you; the two-item stage even read Teemo though whys[6], spikes[3] and late all give it to Urgot.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Teemo x4, Urgot, Teemo, Urgot — which matches whys[0..6] exactly. The chart's 'Skill' rows were hiding a lane the prose describes as clearly Teemo-sided until your level-6 and item spikes.
audit.corrected: Teemo Levels 1 through 4-5, Urgot at Level 6, Teemo at first item, Urgot at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike is stated with a 25% execute number and no reason you can reach him.
audit.why: Riot gives an unnumbered threshold. What makes Level 6 yours is range: Corrosive Charge is 800 to Blinding Dart's 680, so you can slow him from outside the blind and then flip. Teemo's mushrooms also only exist from 6, which is his own counter-spike.
audit.corrected: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 to his 680 — slow him from outside blind range, then flip and execute below the threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Blinding Dart 'blinds your shotguns' with no cooldown, no range, and no statement of what it does NOT stop.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank at 680 range. Purge's bolts count as basic attacks, so the blind blanks Purge as well as your autos — the mirror verified this against the Wiki because Echoing Flames' text lists them separately. Corrosive Charge and Disdain are abilities and land regardless. Toxic Shot applies on-hit and scales with attack speed, so armour alone misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: The blind is 7s flat and blanks Purge as well as your autos, but never Corrosive Charge or Disdain — trade with those while it is up, and commit the full pattern the moment it is spent.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your shotguns. Fight when it’s down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Blinding Dart: 7s flat at every rank, 680 range. It blanks Purge too — the bolts count as basic attacks. Your Q still lands.

edits.before: Blinds your shotguns. Fight when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It blanks Purge as well as your autos, but never your Q or Disdain. Fight at 7s.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Noxious Trap is his ult — no mushroom exists on the map before level 6.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Teemo is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online — Q slows from 800, outside his 680 blind, then the flip puts him under the threshold.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Teemo carry threat: 8/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Teemo carry threat: 8/10 — end before he cashes it.

edits.before: Teemo's level-1 Blinding Dart neuters your autos and W damage.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blanks your autos and Purge — his blind is 7s flat.

edits.before: R Fear Beyond Death is your equalizer — if you can force Teemo into your Q slow and land the flip, you delete him, since his squishy frame folds instantly once you actually catch him.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death is your equalizer: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 to his 680, so slow him from outside the blind, then flip and execute — his frame folds the moment you land it.

notes: The packet itself flags this chart as contradicting the data (52.43% for Urgot, chart giving Teemo 5 of 7 stages). The chart now matches packet.levelChart and, more importantly, matches this page's own whys[] — the win rate is carried by the level-6 and two-item stages rather than by lane control. Confirmed rather than corrected: the blind DOES blank Purge, because the Wiki treats Purge's bolts as basic attacks even though Echoing Flames' tooltip lists them separately — recorded so it is not 'fixed' back later.
